purpose: Establish an executable v2 target semantic contract while preserving the active graph until the approval-bound W12 migration lifecycle is authorized.
enforced_target_rules: Ownership and leadership are distinct typed relations; OWNS_OR_LEADS is forbidden in v2.
Generic RELATED_TO cannot express a decision relationship.
Every v2 relationship has non-empty source assertion IDs.
PartnerAdvisory support must identify a bounded support scope; ALL and UNSPECIFIED are rejected.
Status, metric, dependency, and readiness assertions are observations with time and source qualifiers.
Decision and derived artifacts cannot become canonical evidence through this contract.

legacy_graph_audit.interpretation: W13 intentionally did not normalize the active graph. This debt remains controlled W12 migration scope.

next_gate: W12 exact human-decision resolution and approval-bound migration lifecycle
